key_points: Disney creates first-ever CTO role, hiring Karandeep Anand (ex-Character.ai CEO) to lead enterprise tech and AI platforms
Theme parks outperform competitors (Universal, SeaWorld) with price cuts and promotions boosting FL/CA attendance
Multi-year strategic alliance announced with Kraft Heinz
Analyst commentary mixed: Wells Fargo sees 40% upside if Disney exits streaming; Morgan Stanley outlines path to $125
SimplyWall.st estimates stock ~24% below fair value
